{{Short description|Tunisian politician (1953-2015)}}
[[Image:Moncef Ben Salem.jpg|300px|thumb|Moncef Ben Salem]]
'''Moncef Ben Salem''' ({{langx|aeb|المنصف بن سالم}}; February 1, 1953 – March 24, 2015) was a Tunisian politician and  university professor.<ref>{{in lang|fr}} [http://www.babnet.net/cadredetail-43037.asp] Babnet Dec'24th 2011</ref><ref>[http://www.leaders.com.tn/article/10175-moncef-ben-salem-nomme-professeur-de-l-enseignement-superieur] leaders.com: Moncef is named a professor again</ref> He served as minister of [[higher education]] and [[scientific research]] under Prime Minister [[Hamadi Jebali]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20070612234542/https://www.cia.gov/library/publications/world-leaders-1/world-leaders-t/tunisia.html CIA World Leaders]</ref><ref name="leaders">{{Cite news|url=http://www.leaders.com.tn/article/moncef-ben-salem?id=7309|title=Moncef Ben Salem|work=Leaders|access-date=2017-11-16|language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref name="agence">[http://www.tap.info.tn/fr/fr/politique/300-politique/15360-biographie-de-m-moncef-ben-salem-nouveau-ministre-de-lenseignement-superieur-et-de-la-recherche-scientifique.html Biographie de M. Moncef Ben Salem, nouveau ministre de l'Enseignement superieur et de la recherche scientifique] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120107175726/http://tap.info.tn/fr/fr/politique/300-politique/15360-biographie-de-m-moncef-ben-salem-nouveau-ministre-de-lenseignement-superieur-et-de-la-recherche-scientifique.html |date=2012-01-07 }}, Agence Tunis Afrique Presse, 24 December 2011</ref><ref name="live">Ahmed Medien, [http://www.tunisia-live.net/2011/12/12/moncef-ben-salem/ Moncef Ben Salem] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121014114353/http://www.tunisia-live.net/2011/12/12/moncef-ben-salem/ |date=2012-10-14 }} ''Tunisia Live'', 12 December 2011</ref>

==Biography==

===Early life===
Moncef Ben Salem was born on 1 April 1953. He received a BA degree in Mathematics and Physics 1972 and a master's degree in Maths in 1974.<ref name="leaders"/><ref name="agence"/><ref name="fields">[http://www.fields.utoronto.ca/press/11-12/120320Salem.html Dr. Moncef Ben Salem to visit the Fields Institute], [[Fields Institute]], 20 March 2012</ref> He received PhDs in Maths and Physics from the [[University of Toulouse]] and [[Supméca]] in Paris.<ref name="leaders"/><ref name="agence"/><ref name="fields"/> He was a member of the [[Union of Arab Mathematicians and Physicians]] from 1980 to 1987.<ref name="fields"/> He co-founded the [[Ecole Nationale d'Ingénieurs de Sfax]] in 1983 <ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.leaders.com.tn/article/10175-moncef-ben-salem-nomme-professeur-de-l-enseignement-superieur|title=Moncef Ben Salem nommé professeur de l'enseignement supérieur|work=Leaders|access-date=2017-11-16|language=fr-FR}}</ref>

===Political activism and career===
He was a member of the [[Ennahda Movement]].<ref name="live"/> He was critical of Presidents [[Habib Bourguiba]] and [[Zine El Abidine Ben Ali]], calling Bourguiba a "[[zionism|zionist]]".<ref name="live"/> As a result of his political activism under Ben Ali, he was jailed for eighteen months from 1987 to 1989, and from 1990 to 1993.<ref name="live"/> In 1987, his passport was revoked, and he was forbidden from leaving Tunisia or travelling inside the country for twenty years, as were his children.<ref name="leaders"/><ref name="agence"/> From 1993 to 2011, he was forced to live under [[surveillance]].<ref name="live"/> He was also forbidden to work as a university professor.<ref name="leaders"/><ref name="agence"/> During those years, he was supported by the [[Canadian Committee of Scientists and Scholars]] and the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref name="fields"/> He later taught at the [[University of Maryland]] in the US, at the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] in France, Italy, Germany, Belgium, and at the [[University of Sfax]] in Tunisia.<ref name="leaders"/><ref name="live"/><ref name="fields"/>

===Minister===
On 20 December 2011, after former President Ben Ali was deposed, he joined the [[Jebali Cabinet]] as Minister of Higher Education.<ref name="leaders"/><ref name="live"/><ref name="fields"/>

===Death===
He died on March 24, 2015, leaving a widow and 4 children.<ref name="leaders"/><ref>{{in lang|fr}} [http://www.businessnews.com.tn/deces-de-moncef-ben-salem,520,54612,3 Death of Moncef Ben Salem] Business News March 24, 2015</ref><ref>[https://www.facebook.com/AlmutawasitTV/posts/660341314071460] {{in lang|ar}}</ref>
